The <b>Moss Druid</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are a crazed druid living in the recesses of the [[Mosshome]] above [[Bone Bottom]]. They offer the <i>[[Berry Picking]]</i> [[Wish]] and provide the [[Mossberry Stew]] for the <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i> Wish.

== Background ==
Moss Druid hints that they might be the only one of their kind.<ref>Moss Druid: <i>"An amulet of we druids. Or me druid? No others, I think."</i></ref> They seek [[Mossberry|Mossberries]] to use in their stew. They try to listen to the rhythm of [[Pharloom]].<ref>Moss Druid: <i>"Mmmm! Is it time? Our lands shake their sorrow! For the new beat, yes? Demanding! For a new rhythm..."</i></ref> The stew's fumes give them visions, particularly about [[Skarrsinger Karmelita]], [[Nyleth]] and [[Crust King Khann]].<ref>Moss Druid: <i>"Mmm! Mmm! This is them, the precious, promised fruits!
Drop them in, there they go, and now at last we can begin!
Ahhh! Ahhh-ohhhh! The smell is right! Like the others! But very young! Oh, voice of the woods! Oh, dance of the queen! Oh... oh! Beat harder, let us hear it! Oh! Ohhhhhhhh!
Mmm. Mmm! The pain... my mind aches. Why? The berries, the nasty fruits. Oh the visions!"</i></ref><ref>Moss Druid: <i>"Beating, beating... In coral, in shell... Beat beat beat! The world's rhythms... In branches, in fields! And why not here?!"</i></ref> [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is their only friend.<ref>Moss Druid: <i>"Enough berries. We need no more. For you though, my one and only friend. My beloved. A reward!"</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
Upon their first encounter, Moss Druid asks [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to bring them 3 [[Mossberry|Mossberries]] for the potion they're brewing. Alternatively, the Wish can be accepted at [[Bone Bottom]]'s [[Wishwall]]. Bringing at least 3 Mossberries back to Moss Druid prompts them to reward Hornet with the [[Druid's Eye]]. Moss Druid then mentions that they will reward in [[Rosaries]] for any extra Mossberries that Hornet brings back. For each extra Mossberry delivered, the number of rosaries gained is either {{R|131}}, {{R|157}}, or {{R|173}}, with an order chosen randomly at the beginning of the game.

There are 4 extra Mossberries total, and once all 4 have been delivered, Moss Druid upgrades the Druid's Eye into the [[Druid's Eyes]].

During the <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i> wish, Moss Druid gives the [[Mossberry Stew]].

== Location ==
Moss Druid can be found in a cave in the northeast of [[Mosshome]] in [[Bone Bottom]]. The area can be accessed after binding the [[Silkspear]] skill to break through the Silk threads blocking the way.
